# ADVISOR

> ADVISOR is an MCP server for the Wayne State app stack. Your coding agent asks it about our standards, supported versions, docs and checks, and it answers read-only from the stack's own files.

Front page: [`site/index.html`](https://github.com/waynestate/advisor/blob/HEAD/site/index.html), a static field map of the stack (open it in a browser).

On Citadel it is served by the raw-PHP deploy layer in [`deploy/`](https://github.com/waynestate/advisor/blob/HEAD/deploy/): a Squire kit whose front controller serves `site/` behind HELMET's security headers. For local development, keep serving `site/` directly.

Checks: `composer ci` (the same command runs on GitLab and GitHub).

Documentation: the full docs live at [`site/docs/index.html`](https://github.com/waynestate/advisor/blob/HEAD/site/docs/index.html), built from `docs/` by the shared docs builder (`composer docs`). The docs wear the front page's look through the builder's `theme` key in `docs/docs.json`: [`docs/_header.html`](https://github.com/waynestate/advisor/blob/HEAD/docs/_header.html) is the sheet head every docs page gets (keep its links in step with the front page's), and [`docs/theme/advisor.css`](https://github.com/waynestate/advisor/blob/HEAD/docs/theme/advisor.css) holds the paper, Fraunces titles, code ground, callouts and the derived dark mode; the build copies it to `site/docs/theme/`. Edit those two files, never `site/assets/docs.css` or `docs.js` (Squire's kit), then run `composer docs`. The back of the map, now with the same legend as the front.

Every page below is Markdown. The HTML pages send the same Markdown to a client that asks for `text/markdown`. Written by Squire's agent-ready kit from the README and the pages; do not edit.

## Prompts

- [Get started with ADVISOR](https://advisor.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-get-started): The agent installs ADVISOR, shows you the client config before writing it, and asks its first question once it's connected. The prompt itself is in https://advisor.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
- [ADVISOR in a Laravel app, beside Boost](https://advisor.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-laravel): Uses the laravel/mcp adapter and adds ADVISOR to your client next to Boost, without touching Boost's entry. The prompt itself is in https://advisor.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
